name: thinkercise
description: Pixi works out in a pane while Claude works: pixel-art exercises matched to how hard your prompt is, as rated by a locally hosted torchcast-decision-12b.

llm_url.title: LLM endpoint
llm_url.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions URL of the locally hosted model

llm_model.title: LLM model
llm_model.description: Model name sent to the endpoint

pane_columns.title: Pane width (docked)
pane_columns.description: Body columns asked for when the pane docks beside the transcript (fullscreen mode); the sprite fills it

pane_rows.title: Pane height (inline)
pane_rows.description: Body rows asked for when the pane sits above the prompt; Claude Code caps it at a third of the terminal

cell_aspect.title: Cell aspect ratio
cell_aspect.description: Width of a terminal cell divided by its height, so the sprite comes out square: 0.5 for most fonts, 0.43 for Iosevka, 0.6 for wide ones

log_decisions.title: Record decisions
log_decisions.description: Keep each prompt's verdict and what the turn really cost under ~/.thinkercise/decisions, so tools/eval can tune the estimator
